statusDetail: Coverage-complete remote audit across seven representative paths. Not covered: comment submission, ad-click conversion, and authenticated account/payment flows because none were required for the public editorial core journey.

page.notes: French football news MPA with server-rendered content, client-side filters/modals, advertising integrations, manifest and service worker.

checkOutcomes.method: Dark screenshot and computed-style/CSS preference probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical to the light desktop screenshot; the computed root color-scheme is normal and the CSS feature probe found no prefers-color-scheme, color-scheme or light-dark() usage.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() still returned four running animations with 3500 ms durations; the CSS feature probe found no reduced-motion media rule.

checkOutcomes.method: Contrast preference probe plus Lighthouse contrast audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The stylesheet probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling; Lighthouse also identified near-invisible betting-odds text at 1.08:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Full CSS/DOM feature probe across route and tab UI.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The complete live CSS/HTML feature probe found no view-transition rules or startViewTransition use even though the site has route and tab state changes.

Home mobile layout recorded CLS 0 with no shifts; Lighthouse CLS was 0.007 and all 100 audited images had dimensions.

checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR recorded 45 scripts and 803 KB script transfer; Lighthouse estimates 358 KiB unused JS, including 75% of GPT, 81% of Prebid and 61% of Amazon publisher.js.
On /joueur/, “Filtrer” is an <a role="button" data-modal> with no href and no tabindex; custom modal containers also lack dialog semantics.
Lighthouse measured two odds values at 1.08:1 and the red bonus CTA at 4.33:1, below the required 4.5:1 for this text size.
Lighthouse passed heading order and one-main-landmark; the focus probe showed native visible outlines on sampled links.
Article and listing screenshots show readable line lengths, clear spacing and unclipped text at 360 px, aside from the separately reported contrast issue.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The rendered meta viewport is width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no; Lighthouse failed its meta-viewport accessibility audit.
Lighthouse errors-in-console audit passed with no captured console errors.
Lighthouse passed doctype, charset and image aspect ratio; the image primitive found dimensions on all 100 images.
Lighthouse passed BFCache, deprecations, source maps, notification-on-start and geolocation-on-start audits.
Homepage and article probes found unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse crawlable-anchor audit, viewport and robots evidence.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse SEO found an <a class="button" data-modal> with no href for “Partage ta réponse”.
Both home and article return 200 with canonical URLs; robots allows crawling and points to two valid sitemap locations.
The article exposes matching Open Graph metadata plus NewsArticle, BreadcrumbList and Speakable JSON-LD with author, dates and images.
HTTPS, HSTS and X-Frame-Options are present, but CSP and X-Content-Type-Options are missing; didomi_token and inter-cap were set without Secure.
The tracker probe found 18 third-party origins and four known trackers; HAR attributes 37 requests and 649 KB, 65% of transfer, to third parties.

checkOutcomes.reason: No permission request or authentication flow exists on the exercised surfaces; Mon FM stores favourites without an account form.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The headers primitive found no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; CSP is also absent, while HSTS and DENY framing are correctly configured.
Discoverability captures report 99% homepage and 100% article content coverage without JavaScript; neither page is a JS shell.
Representative mobile listings, sticky navigation, filter surfaces and article content rendered without clipping or broken async state.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest, service-worker registration and fetched sw.js logic.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A valid manifest and active service worker exist, but sw.js only caches /build/ static assets and its fetch handler has no navigation fallback.
The invalid route returns a purpose-built 404 screen with plain-language context and a visible home recovery action.
The document declares lang=fr and all representative content preserves French reading order and text rendering.
Dates, match times and season labels are presented consistently in French locale conventions across article, live and TV templates.
Article metadata uses explicit ISO-8601 offsets for published and modified timestamps, avoiding ambiguous stored instants.
Initial, article, listing and favourites screenshots show no nagging consent wall, confirmshaming, forced continuity or hidden cancellation.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten Most Read/Flash tab cycles, heap self-size decreased from 21,239,298 to 21,185,063 bytes rather than growing without bound.
Heap summaries remained near 21.2 MB self-size for this content-heavy page and the post interaction DOM contained 1,947 elements.
Before/after heap constructor summaries showed no Detached* population among retained top constructors and closures changed only 21,657 to 21,730 after ten cycles.

principleOutcomes.reason: This editorial news site exposes machine-readable articles but no transactional capability that needs WebMCP or agentic form/tool registration. No summarisation or generative user task was offered; built-in on-device inference is an optional emerging enhancement rather than a requirement for reading news.

paths.description: Homepage and news feed, the primary discovery surface; exercised desktop, mobile, dark, reduced-motion, crawler and performance conditions.
Representative article/detail template and primary read-content journey; exercised desktop, mobile, crawler and metadata states.
Match listing and live-data archetype, selected for dense cards, filters and frequently refreshed content.
Player ranking/listing archetype, selected to inspect filter controls, dense tabular content and touch interaction.
Programme listing archetype, representing date navigation and compact match cards.
Personalised favourites surface, inspected to establish whether account/authentication and empty-state flows apply.
Deliberate invalid route used to verify HTTP/navigation recovery and a useful 404 state.

findings.summary: The site does not follow the system dark-colour preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical to the light desktop screenshot; the computed root color-scheme is normal and the CSS feature probe found no prefers-color-scheme, color-scheme or light-dark() usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide system-driven dark surface, text, icon and browser-chrome colours.

findings.summary: Long-running animations continue when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() still returned four running animations with 3500 ms durations; the CSS feature probe found no reduced-motion media rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce override that removes non-essential animation and auto-advance while preserving state cues.

findings.summary: There is no explicit high-contrast or forced-colours adaptation.
findings.evidence: The stylesheet probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling; Lighthouse also identified near-invisible betting-odds text at 1.08:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve system colours in forced-colours mode and add prefers-contrast adjustments for low-contrast labels and controls.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The complete live CSS/HTML feature probe found no view-transition rules or startViewTransition use even though the site has route and tab state changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for tabs and cross-document transitions for compatible article/list navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Sticky navigation does not adapt to scroll state.
findings.evidence: Desktop/mobile screenshots show persistent fixed chrome, while the CSS feature probe found no scroll-state container query, scroll timeline or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state queries or a lightweight declarative progress/shrinking treatment so long feeds and articles communicate position.

findings.summary: Modal and filter controls are built from generic elements rather than native dismissible primitives.
findings.evidence: The live DOM contains multiple div.modal elements with no dialog role and player filtering is an <a role="button"> without href; no dialog elements were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace modal divs with <dialog> and transient UI with popover; use real <button> controls and preserve focus/light-dismiss behaviour.

findings.summary: A large reserved advertising region pushes primary content below the desktop fold.
findings.evidence: The 1440x1000 homepage screenshot devotes roughly 290 vertical pixels of the first viewport to an empty grey ad slot; the lead story begins around y=520.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse empty ad slots and reserve only the minimum proven creative size; prioritise the lead story in the initial viewport.

findings.summary: Mobile templates overflow the viewport by 4 px.
findings.evidence: Layout captures on both home and live report scrollWidth 364 against clientWidth 360.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the overflowing width/gutter and use intrinsic sizing so scrollWidth never exceeds the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Reusable components rely on viewport styling rather than container queries.
findings.evidence: The full stylesheet probe found zero @container rules; the same dense cards and tables appear in multiple widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards, match rows and tables containment and adapt them with size-aware container queries.

findings.summary: The player filter is not a natively keyboard-operable control.
findings.evidence: On /joueur/, “Filtrer” is an <a role="button" data-modal> with no href and no tabindex; custom modal containers also lack dialog semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real <button> with an accessible name and declarative dialog/popover association; manage initial and return focus.

findings.summary: Betting-odds content fails minimum colour contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured two odds values at 1.08:1 and the red bonus CTA at 4.33:1, below the required 4.5:1 for this text size.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken muted odds text/background combinations and adjust the CTA red until all text meets WCAG AA contrast.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly prevents user zoom.
findings.evidence: The rendered meta viewport is width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no; Lighthouse failed its meta-viewport accessibility audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1; allow at least 5x zoom and verify reflow at 200–400%.

findings.summary: Mobile Largest Contentful Paint is slow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 7.6 s (performance 0.73), far outside the 2.5 s good threshold, despite low CLS and 80 ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element, prioritize its request, reduce ad/consent competition, and defer non-critical third-party scripts.

findings.summary: Advertising and consent JavaScript dominates the load and is mostly unused at startup.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 45 scripts and 803 KB script transfer; Lighthouse estimates 358 KiB unused JS, including 75% of GPT, 81% of Prebid and 61% of Amazon publisher.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Load advertising/consent integrations conditionally after consent or proximity, trim bidder integrations, and split page-specific first-party managers.

findings.summary: A parser-inserted advertising bootstrap remains render-blocking.
findings.evidence: HAR marked optiyield pfc as parser-inserted, High priority; DOM confirmation shows the resulting pfc script lacks defer/async, while many other candidates are correctly deferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the advertising bootstrap asynchronous or defer it until after critical content and consent state are ready.

findings.summary: A share action is exposed as a non-crawlable anchor.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO found an <a class="button" data-modal> with no href for “Partage ta réponse”.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <button> for actions, or provide a real canonical share URL when navigation is intended.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie flags are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS and X-Frame-Options are present, but CSP and X-Content-Type-Options are missing; didomi_token and inter-cap were set without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, add nosniff, and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest appropriate SameSite/HttpOnly settings.

findings.summary: The default page load has a large tracking and advertising footprint.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe found 18 third-party origins and four known trackers; HAR attributes 37 requests and 649 KB, 65% of transfer, to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate non-essential analytics/ads on consent, batch analytics, and enforce a documented third-party byte/request budget.

findings.summary: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; CSP is also absent, while HSTS and DENY framing are correctly configured.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter) Referrer-Policy, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and frame-ancestors in CSP.

findings.summary: The installable experience has no document-level offline fallback.
findings.evidence: A valid manifest and active service worker exist, but sw.js only caches /build/ static assets and its fetch handler has no navigation fallback.
findings.suggestedFix: Precache a small offline document and handle navigation failures with a useful retry/offline state while retaining network-first freshness for news.

findings.summary: News imagery is not consistently responsive or modern-format.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 24 oversized images, 9 without srcset, 11 legacy-format images and no modern-format image among 100 images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, add width-based srcset/sizes, and request assets close to rendered dimensions.

findings.summary: Third-party advertising consumes most transferred bytes before user interaction.
findings.evidence: HAR measured 649 KB third-party transfer out of 1.01 MB total; DoubleClick alone transferred 262 KB and consent/ads occupy the largest script offenders.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce a third-party budget, delay auctions until needed, and remove low-value bidders and duplicate measurement.

taskList.title: Cut LCP and third-party startup cost
Restore zoom and fix player filter semantics
Deploy CSP, cookie flags and defensive policies
Implement system dark, reduced-motion and contrast modes
Collapse empty ad space and keep content above the fold
Replace custom modal/action elements with platform primitives
Remove mobile overflow and adopt container queries
Add declarative route/tab and scroll-state transitions
